versions.content: It shall be possible to configure the BswM to execute the mode arbitration immediately upon a mode arbitration request. This is configured by set- ting the BswMRequestProcessing configuration parameter (within the BswMMod- eRequestPort container) to BSWM_IMMEDIATE.
